category: file and video host (free account, premium)

free_tier.stated: Free account: 10480 MB maximum upload, 2000 GB of storage, unlimited download volume, 1500 Kbytes/sec download speed, files expire after 12 days without downloads.

per_object_cap.stated: 10480 MB per file on Free; 20480 MB on Premium

retention.stated: 12 days with no downloads on Free; 28 days on Premium

egress.terms: Download volume is Unlimited on both tiers; download speed is 1500 Kbytes/sec on Free and 2000 Kbytes/sec on Premium.

interface_detail: Web upload; the site links an API Docs page that was not read. Remote URL upload is 15 threads on Free and 200 on Premium.
tooling: Browser upload, remote URL upload and an API Docs page (unread).
chaining: Premium is $29.99 for 30 days, $69.99 for 90 days, $149.99 for 180 days, $299 for 365 days; it raises the storage to 10000 GB and the per-file cap to 20480 MB.

limits.value: 10480 MB per file on Free, 20480 MB on Premium
download speed 1500 Kbytes/sec on Free, 2000 Kbytes/sec on Premium
files expire after 12 days with no downloads on Free, 28 days on Premium
2000 GB of storage on Free, 10000 GB on Premium

binding_note: A 12-day no-download expiry binds before the 2000 GB storage or the per-file cap does.

identity_cost.detail: The registration form asks for a username, an e-mail, a password and a reCAPTCHA check. Premium is paid by Bitcoin, Litecoin, PayPal or Stripe.

reliability_note: Files expire 12 days after the last download on the free tier; the registration form sits behind a reCAPTCHA.
confidence_note: Limits and prices read on the vendor premium and registration pages. Whether a file can be fetched without a browser challenge was not probed.
